# SOP-P2-L4-05 Planned shutdown - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-RR01, EQ-P2-L4-HT02, EQ-P2-L4-HP03  
Related documents: MM-P2-L4-HT02, SB-1007, SOP-P2-L4-04

1. Purpose
1.1. Provide required sequence to perform a planned shutdown of the Heat Treat line and place equipment in a safe state for maintenance and inspection.

2. Preconditions
2.1. All shift production activities must be stopped and cleared from the line per SOP-P2-L4-04.
2.2. Maintenance crew briefed referencing MM-P2-L4-HT02 and SB-1007.
2.3. Operators confirm availability of required spares and consumables.

3. PPE
3.1. Required items: safety glasses, hearing protection, flame-retardant coveralls, safety boots, and insulated gloves for thermal work.
3.2. Verify PPE condition before entering the work area.

4. Shutdown sequence (execute in order)
4.1. Stop feed to EQ-P2-L4-RR01 and isolate material ingress.
4.2. Lockout-tagout electrical supply to EQ-P2-L4-RR01, EQ-P2-L4-HT02, and EQ-P2-L4-HP03 following site LOTO procedure.
4.3. Bleed and isolate hydraulic systems on EQ-P2-L4-HP03 per MM-P2-L4-HT02.
4.4. Secure gas and furnace controls on EQ-P2-L4-HT02; verify controls are in manual-off.
4.5. Depressurize ancillary pneumatic lines and verify zero pressure using approved gauges.
4.6. Drain and collect lubricants and fluids where required; document locations and quantities per SB-1007.
4.7. Tag equipment with hold for maintenance notices and update shift log.

5. Lubrication notes
5.1. The lubricant part number for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is CFW-LUB-723.
5.2. The lubricant part number for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is CFW-LUB-450.

6. Post-shutdown verification
6.1. Walkdown by maintenance lead to confirm isolation, drained fluids, and that PPE zones are cleared.
6.2. Complete the shutdown checklist and attach to work order referenced in MM-P2-L4-HT02.

7. Sign-off
7.1. Operator name / signature: ______________________
7.2. Maintenance lead name / signature: ______________________
7.3. Engineering approval name / signature: ______________________
